comparison.objective: Hold a seedling upright while pouring soil clods around it, then leave it standing.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus bulk pouring and burial versus bimanual screen agitation that passes small media while retaining larger rings.
comparison.success_condition: Seedling centered/upright/on hole floor, at least 32 of 45 clods in hole, released and still 2 s.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate multiple loose bodies, but this tests filling around a retained plant rather than aperture-based selective separation.
